MUTANT AMPHISBAENA PURPLE WORM
CR 15

XP 51,200
Mutant purple worm amphisbaena creature
N Gargantuan aberration (magical beast)
Init –3; Senses all-around vision, darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 3, flat-footed 27 (–3 Dex, +24 natural, –4 size)
hp 256 (19 HD; 3d8+16d10+152)
Fort +19, Ref +8, Will +3
Defensive Abilities split; Immune mind-affecting effects, radiation; Resist cold 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., burrow 20 ft., swim 10 ft.
Melee 2 bites +34 (4d8+18/19–20 plus grab plus radiation), 2 claws +33 (2d6+18), sting +34 (2d8+18)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks poison, special attacks, swallow whole (4d8+18, AC 22, 25 hp)

TACTICS

Before Combat The worm uses its tremorsense to locate the PCs in the streets above and follows them.

During Combat The worm is tough, emerging from the sand and attacking two creatures, hoping to swallow them whole and take them below. If it swallows two prey it burrows deep below the ground to digest them.

Morale The worm burrows away if reduced to 35 hit points or less.

STATISTICS

Str 47, Dex 4, Con 27, Int 1, Wis 4, Cha 8
Base Atk +19; CMB +41 (+43 bull rush, +45 grapple); CMD 48 (50 vs. bull rush, can’t be tripped)
Feats Awesome Blow, Crippling Critical, Critical Focus, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Power Attack, Staggering Critical, Weapon Focus (bite), Weapon Focus (sting)
Skills Acrobatics –3 (–7 to jump), Perception +23, Swim +26; Racial Modifiers racial skill modifier
SQ deformities (spasms), mutations (armored, feral, radioactive bite, greater rage (0), sealed mind)
